response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT f.zoneref AS site_code, s.entrystat AS access_status, AVG(f.traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanfeatures AS f INNER JOIN sites AS s ON f.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE f.traitcount >= 489 GROUP BY f.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT site_code, access_status, avg_traitcount, record_count, record_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(record_count) OVER (), 0) AS record_fraction FROM grouped ORDER BY record_fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
